# Claudemy

Turn any topic into a short audio course: it researches the topic on the web, maps what good sources agree and disagree on, then writes and renders a set of about two-minute two-host audio lessons (12 by default), each with a one-screen card, one small thing to try, and citations traced to pages it actually read. A class can also be built from one named person's published work.
